title: Josh Boutwood Comes Home to Boracay for an Exclusive Dining Experience
summary: Two-Michelin-starred chef Josh Boutwood returns to Boracay for a three-night residency at Shangri-La Boracay, serving a six-course dinner at Rima Treetop Dining from November 25 to 27, 2026.
